review_evidence: AKLT.lean: Defines akltTensor (MPSTensor 3 2), proves aklt_not_isInjective, aklt_isNormal, aklt_transferMap_one, aklt_isOnSiteSymmetric_Z2, aklt_isOnSiteSymmetric_Z2Z2, and cohomological invariants (akltOmega, akltProjRep, aklt_isNontrivialSPT)

Cluster.lean: Defines clusterTensor (MPSTensor 2 2), clusterBlocked, clusterZ2Z2Action; proves cluster_not_isInjective, cluster_isNormal, clusterBlocked_isInjective, cluster_isOnSiteSymmetric_Z2Z2, clusterOmega_isCocycle, cluster_isNontrivialSPT, cluster_hasStringOrder, clusterBlocked_transferMap_idempotent

GHZ.lean: Defines ghzTensor, ghzSectorTensor, z2PhysicalAction; proves ghz_transferMap_idempotent, ghz_not_isInjective, ghzSectorTensor_isInjective, ghz_isOnSiteSymmetric_Z2, ghz_virtual_Z2_symmetric, ghz_orderParam_fixed

KitaevChain.lean: Defines kitaevTensor, kitaevTwist, kitaevTwistedCoeff, kitaevSectorTensor; proves kitaevTensor_one_mul_self, kitaevTensor_evalWord, kitaevTensor_coeff, kitaevTwistedCoeff_eq, kitaevTensor_not_isInjective, kitaevTensor_not_isNormal, kitaevTwistedCoeff_eq_add, kitaevSectorTensor_isInjective

MajumdarGhosh.lean: Defines majumdarGhoshTensor; proves majumdarGhosh_left_canonical, majumdarGhosh_transferMap_one, majumdarGhosh_not_isInjective, majumdarGhosh_not_isNBlkInjective_one, majumdarGhosh_not_isNormal

Fibonacci/Fibonacci.lean: Defines fibTauGolden, fibOneGolden, fibStackGolden, fibGaugeGolden, fibGaugeInvGolden; proves fibTauMPS_isNormal, fibOneMPS_isNormal, fibonacci_compression (multi-block), fibonacci_fusion_rule, fibonacci_dim_eq, fibonacci_remainder_eq_zero
CZX/CZXTensor.lean: Defines czxIntTensor, czxTensor, czxMPS, czxSquareInt, czxSquare; proves czxMPS_isNormal, czxSquare_eq
WState.lean: Defines wTensor, wLeftBoundary, wRightBoundary, wIndicator; proves evalWord_wTensor, wTensor_openState_eq_wIndicator
ZMod2.lean: Shared lemmas for Z₂/Z₂×Z₂ symmetries (zmod2_cases, zmod2sq_cases, ofCommutingInvolutions, mul_of_anticommuting_involutions) used by AKLT/Cluster examples

summary: All 189 files in this work unit contain formal mathematical content (definitions, theorems, proofs) related to tensor network examples and should remain in the primary search index. The files include concrete MPS tensor definitions (AKLT, Cluster, GHZ, Kitaev chain, Majumdar-Ghosh, Fibonacci, CZX, CZY, W state, etc.), their properties (injectivity, normality, transfer maps, symmetries), and advanced structures (anomalous condensation, multi-block compressions, RFP candidates, ring-based exact arithmetic). Four files (CZX.lean, Fibonacci.lean, MultiBlock.lean, RFP.lean, Rings.lean, AnomalousCondensation.lean) are pure import aggregators generated by a script, but they contain no declarations of their own and serve as navigation modules — per FILTER-007, these should retain primary eligibility with navigation-import-only role metadata since the auxiliary search delivery path is not verified.
